sar.narrative: A Suspicious Activity Report is warranted for CASE-009 based on evidence of a coordinated micro-payment fraud ring. The investigation identified transaction 4012185 ($14.50) scored at 0.48 risk, part of a pattern involving four affected transactions totaling $2,102.44 in exposure [EV-1ff4cb50]. Device fingerprint analysis linked 10 cards (SC-09000-K1 through SC-09009-K2) to a shared device profile observed across 17 cards total, with 4 confirmed fraud cards in the device component forming a ring of 18 cards [EV-2a6bbd59, EV-1e830632]. The flagged card SC-03009-K955 exhibited anomalous velocity with 4 online transactions in 48 hours, deviating from its $3.00 historical average [EV-d4b3c582, EV-f83804d1]. The customer reported no authorization of the transactions and confirmed physical card possession, supporting unauthorized use [EV-5ceb1577]. Historical review revealed five prior cases with card_testing patterns and one legitimate travel-related case for this customer [EV-224ebd8d, EV-5bd8c37a]. The undocumented pattern designation reflects novel characteristics not matching established typologies, though the device-sharing ring structure is consistent with organized fraud operations. Total exposure of $2,102.44 across four transactions warrants SAR filing under regulatory thresholds for coordinated fraud activity. The case was closed with a fraud verdict at 0.808 probability based on the convergence of device-linkage, velocity anomalies, customer dispute, and ring confirmation. No further action is recommended beyond standard SAR filing and ring monitoring, as the fraud network has been identified and contained.
